item: The activity ledger's skipped note is checked whole before its 200-character cut; field-test step errors get a test
summary: note=str(skipped)[:200] cut the text before anything checked it (every caller passed a literal today, so latent): it is now checked whole, then cut, with a straddle test that goes red without it. A field-test step that fails records its error through record_text; a test now fails if that goes.
